<module id="multi_pipe_4bit">
    <description>Design a 4-bit unsigned number pipelined multiplier. The multiplier has two levels of registers to store intermediate values and control the multiplication process.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal for synchronization.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="mul_a" width_description="[3:0]">Multiplier A input.</input>
        <input id="mul_b" width_description="[3:0]">Multiplier B input.</input>
        <output id="mul_out" width_description="[7:0]">Product output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <param value="4">size</param>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="reg_mul_a" width_description="[size+size-1:0]">Register to hold extended multiplier A.</reg>
        <reg id="reg_mul_b" width_description="[size+size-1:0]">Register to hold extended multiplier B.</reg>
        <reg id="reg_mul_out" width_description="[size+size-1:0]">Register to hold the product output.</reg>
        <reg id="reg_adder" width_description="[size+size-1:0]">Register to hold the sum of partial products.</reg>
        <reg id="reg_partial_product" width_description="[size+size-1:0]">Register to hold the current partial product.</reg>
        
        <for loop_id="i" start_value="0" end_value="size" step_value="1">
            <wire id="partial_product_i" width_description="[size+size-1:0]">Partial product for bit position i.</wire>
        </for>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        <assign reg_mul_a = {size{1'b0}}, mul_a};
        <assign reg_mul_b = {size{1'b0}}, mul_b};
        <always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)> // Register update on positive edge of clk or negative edge of rst_n
            if (~rst_n) begin
                reg_adder <= 'd0;
                reg_partial_product <= 'd0;
            end else begin
                reg_adder <= reg_partial_product + ((reg_mul_b[i]) ? reg_mul_a << i : 'd0);
                reg_partial_product <= reg_adder;
            end
        </always>
        <always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)) // Output calculation on positive edge of clk or negative edge of rst_n
            if (~rst_n) begin
                reg_mul_out <= 'd0;
            end else begin
                reg_mul_out <= reg_adder;
            end
        
        <assign mul_out = reg_mul_out;
    </implementation>
    
</module>
